tools.label: Nudge Left
tools.tooltip: Move the targeted keys left by the Nudge Value.

tools.label: Nudge Right
tools.tooltip: Move the targeted keys right by the Nudge Value.

tools.label: Nudge Value
tools.tooltip: Set the frame count used by every Nudge and Inbetween command.

tools.label: Default Pose
tools.tooltip: Reset targeted attributes to saved defaults or Maya's native defaults.

tools.label: Bake on Ones
tools.tooltip: Bake the active animation context on every frame.

tools.label: Share Keys
tools.tooltip: Add missing shared key times across the active animation channels.

tools.label: Connect to Neighbors
tools.tooltip: Smoothly connect the selected curve segment to its surrounding keys.

tools.label: Tweener
tools.tooltip: Blend values between the previous and next keys.

tools.label: Isolate
tools.tooltip: Isolate the selected character or asset in the active viewport.

tools.label: Selector
tools.tooltip: Open the current selection as a compact list for quick re-selection.

tools.label: Select Rig Controls
tools.tooltip: Select all curve and joint controls in the selected rig hierarchy.

tools.label: Mirror
tools.tooltip: Mirror the selected controls to their opposite-side equivalents. Mirror exceptions can be configured per rig and are saved for reuse.

tools.label: Align Objects
tools.tooltip: Match the selected source objects to the last selected target. Uses translation, rotation, and scale. A selected time range aligns every frame in that range.

tools.label: Copy Pose
tools.tooltip: Copy the current pose from the selected controls. The pose remains available across Maya sessions.

tools.label: Copy Animation
tools.tooltip: Copy animation from the selected objects or controls. The animation remains available across Maya sessions.

tools.label: Bouncy Tangent
tools.tooltip: Fit exaggerated tangent angles that add controlled overshoot around the targeted keys.

tools.label: Auto Tangent
tools.tooltip: Set automatic tangents on the targeted keys.

tools.label: Spline Tangent
tools.tooltip: Set smooth spline tangents on the targeted keys.

tools.label: Step Tangent
tools.tooltip: Hold each key value until the following key.

tools.label: Animation Offset
tools.tooltip: Offset animated controls without changing the shape of their motion. Select animated controls, enable the tool, then transform them with Maya's manipulators.

tools.label: Micro Move
tools.tooltip: Move and rotate selected controls with fine viewport precision. Disable the tool to restore Maya's normal move and rotate contexts.

tools.label: Depth Mover
tools.tooltip: Drag selected transforms toward or away from the active camera while preserving their screen position. Disable the tool to restore Maya's previous interaction context.

tools.label: Temp Pivot
tools.tooltip: Create a temporary pivot that drives the selected controls as one transform. Run the tool again to finish the active pivot session.

tools.label: Follow Cam
tools.tooltip: Create a camera that follows the selected object in translation and rotation. Useful for stabilizing a moving control in view while polishing its animation.

tools.label: Copy Relationship
tools.tooltip: Copy the world-space relationship between selected objects. Select followers first and the driver last.

tools.label: Copy World Space
tools.tooltip: Copy world-space transforms from the selected time range or keys, or from the current frame when nothing is selected.

tools.label: Attribute Switcher
tools.tooltip: Switch configured attributes across selected controls from a compact floating window. Hold Ctrl and click attribute rows to select multiple channels and switch them together. Rotation-order changes can be Euler-filtered automatically.

tools.label: Gimbal Fixer
tools.tooltip: Analyze the selected control's animated rotation and rank all six rotation orders by gimbal risk. Choose an order to convert the animation while preserving the visible motion.

tools.label: Selection Sets
tools.tooltip: Create, organize, rename, and recall persistent selection sets stored with the Maya scene.

tools.label: Orbit
tools.tooltip: Open the configurable Orbit command palette near the cursor. Use its radial arrangement for fast access to frequently repeated animation tools.

tools.label: Tracer
tools.tooltip: Click to create a viewport tracer for the selected object; click again to remove all tracers. Shift-click creates another tracer. Right-click opens tracer settings.

tools.label: Onion Skin
tools.tooltip: Open the Onion Skin manager when you want to compare a pose with nearby frames without leaving the camera view. Add the character meshes, enable onion skins, then scrub through the poses you want to compare. Right-click for a quick change between shaded, shape, and outline views.

tools.label: Pause Viewport
tools.tooltip: Pause the viewport refresh to improve performance. Uncheck to resume normal viewport updates.

tools.label: Snap Keys
tools.tooltip: Move sub-frame keys on the selected objects and animation layers, including layer weights, onto whole frames.

tools.label: Clear Animation
tools.tooltip: Delete animation from the selected objects and animation layers. A highlighted Time Slider range limits which keys are deleted.

tools.label: Remove Redundant Keys
tools.tooltip: Remove redundant keys from the selected objects and animation layers using the mode selected from the right-click menu.

tools.label: Remove Static Anim Curves
tools.tooltip: Remove static animation from the selected objects and animation layers.

tools.label: Custom Tools
tools.tooltip: Open your custom tools and script shortcuts from a single menu. Configure Python, MEL, and callable entries without relying on Maya shelves.

tools.label: Snapshot Rig
tools.tooltip: Capture opposite-control, default-pose and mirror data for the selected rig's controls. Only the selected controls are captured; existing entries for the rest of the rig are left untouched.

tools.label: Background Runners
tools.tooltip: Toggle persistent automatic helpers and background tool runners.

tools.label: Animation Recovery
tools.tooltip: Browse automatic animation and channel snapshots, with alerts when an older scene file is opened. Recover with nothing selected to restore everything, or select objects to restore only those objects.

tools.label: Search
tools.tooltip: Find and run any registered TheKeyMachine command by name. Type to filter, use Up or Down to select a result, then press Enter to run it.
